title: Production of priestly equipment and accessories
description: The chapter describes how the Israelites completed the holy garments for the priest Aaron and his sons: the ephod made of gold and colored wool, the breastpiece with twelve stones representing the tribes of Israel, the robe with bells and pomegranates along its hem, the tunics and turban of fine linen, as well as the plate for the sacred diadem inscribed with "Holy to the Lord". Finally, they brought all the equipment – both the tabernacle and the priestly garments – to Moses, who saw that everything had been done just as the Lord had commanded, and blessed them.
